 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,
1973, for grant of bail during trial.

T h e applicant is facing trial in connection with Crime No.269/2022 registered at Police Station-Sanodha District-Sagar concerning offence under Sections 376, 342 and 506 of IPC and Section 3 & 4 of POCSO Act.
Applicant is in jail since 22.07.2022.

sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that of rape with the prosecutrix.
On the basis of which police registered the aforesaid crime.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
The age of applicant is 19 years.
The applicant and prosecutrix known each other very well and she was a consenting party.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant is in custody since 22.07.2022 and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
There are no criminal antecedents against the applicant.
Under these circumstances, prayer was made for grant of bail to the applicant.
Learned counsel for the objector/respondent has opposed the application.
Learned Panel Lawyer opposed the application and prayed for its rejection, however, it is fairly conceded that there is no criminal antecedents against the applicant.
I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties particularly, the fact that there is no criminal antecedents against the applicant

, on a perusal of the material available on record including the case diary, without commenting on the merits of the case,
this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
This M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
Certified Copy as per rules.
